links.outcome: VLM performance on reasoning-intensive neurology benchmark versus conventional datasets
links.effect: Sharp performance drop on Neural-MedBench compared with conventional datasets; reasoning failures rather than perceptual errors dominate model shortcomings. No numbers given in abstract.
links.quote: Through systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art VLMs, including GPT-4o, Claude-4, and MedGemma, we observe a sharp performance drop compared to conventional datasets.

unlisted_practices: Two-axis evaluation framework combining breadth-oriented large datasets with depth-oriented compact reasoning benchmarks
Hybrid scoring pipeline combining LLM graders, clinician validation, and semantic similarity

screen.reason: Introduces and evaluates multimodal foundation models on Neural-MedBench, an offline benchmark for clinical reasoning in neurology, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
